documents and not against a re-reading of them.

|---|---|---|
| `server-card.schema.v1.json` | `schema.json` of modelcontextprotocol/ext-server-card at commit `526201bbc80231daa40ffcdecfc9da4e54e5dc93` (the snapshot SEP-2127 names) | Apache-2.0 |
| `spec-example.ai-catalog.json` | `specification/examples/ai-catalog.json` of Agent-Card/ai-catalog at commit `e2b425f9e7678a5e6497c5fcff4826d906a4a605` (2026-11-11) | CC-BY-4.0 |

To refresh: fetch the same paths at a newer commit, update the commit ids above, run the tests.
